items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: On bass we had Eddie Barrera.

ctx.x: Well I know that everybody in your mother's family were musicians, you know they're related to all of the Mareros and the Frazier's and everybody. But who in your father's family was interested in music? Was your father interested?

My father was, he could play music also, it was on both sides. He used to play a guitar, but not in a band, you know. He played around the house and played guitar and singing. There was a musical there on both sides. And my mother's sister, she was very musical too, she played the guitar. Now that's, Lawrence Moreira is what I'm speaking about. Now they had Simon Moreira, he played bass like his father. Billy Moreira. People used to say Billy Moran. But it was Billy Moran. Then Simon. And the next boy was John.…
Well did your father encourage you all to play music? Or did he?
